ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels estimated at 0.05:1, localized to scarring and barnacle attachments.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark low-intensity distribution across the majority of the fluke surface; high-contrast focal spots and thin linear disruptions present without large-scale geometric mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 135 degrees; shallow depth relative to vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies from 5 to 20 pixels along the visible boundary, most prominent on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile along the trailing edge, exhibiting an upward sweep towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters (barnacles) concentrated on the distal lateral tips and scattered across the central-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across both lobes, with a prominent long diagonal mark on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both lateral tips; multi-directional linear scarring (rake marks) across the visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography with significant pixel variation compared to smooth-edged specimens.
